items.title: Fred Wesley interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 21, 2024
items.q: But yeah, I got to know Joe Williams real good. He was a good friend of mine.

ctx.x: All right. Well this has been a fascinating chat and I really appreciate the time and the — your memories.
Yeah. Well I appreciate you for asking me all these questions you know. And I see that you’ve got Joe Williams on your wall there.
That’s right. Did you get to play behind him with the Basie band?
